Subject: Critical coverage mapping — temporary backfills & band exception requests

Team —

I'm sending an updated inventory of open reqs and a proposed temporary backfill mapping for critical coverage gaps across infra, runtime, and platform. Given the hiring glidepath for Q1 we need to:

- Identify which open reqs are mission-critical for customer SLAs (latency/reliability)
- Propose short-term backfills (contractor or internal secondment) for roles we won't fill in Q1
- Flag any roles that need a compensation-band exception to avoid losing a finalist (I have one candidate for ENG-IC-5 where comp is a blocker)

I've attached the open_reqs_sheet_Q4_v2.xlsx with a column that maps business-criticality and suggested temporary owner. Please review the shaded rows (priority: P0/P1). Hiring Ops / Greenfield — can you confirm contractor availability and a 60-day FE on-boarding window for contractors?

Asks: 
1) Vivek / Laura: approve the P0 backfills and the single-band-exception (ENG-IC-5) so we can extend an offer this week if needed.
2) Jonas / Evelyn: confirm which teams can spare a 0.5 FTE for rotational coverage through Feb.

I propose we treat this as a short-term realloc and revisit for the Q1 hiring cadence.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: open_reqs_sheet_Q4_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), candidate_summary_ENG-IC-5.pdf (summary)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Hiring Operations <hiringops@acmehr.com>

Thanks Marissa — helpful framing and the sheet is clear. A couple quick questions before I sign off on P0s:

- For the ENG-IC-5 candidate: what total comp are they expecting and what band uplift do you need to match?
- For temporary rotations: which teams would be losing the 0.5 FTE (I want to stress-test impact on delivery dates)?

If the candidate gap for ENG-IC-5 is within a one-band uplift, Laura and I can fast-track a provisional exception with the understanding we capture the business case in the Q1 review. If it's more than one band, we need VP sign-off.

Hiring Ops: please confirm contractor lead time and a vendor rate card for 60/90-day engagements. Greenfield: earliest start dates for an infra SRE contractor?

—Vivek
VP, Engineering Operations
